schedule_design.order_counterbalance: strict baseline-first/candidate-first alternation; 10 observations in each order
schedule_design.gates: identical to the full m4 default-vs-default campaign
schedule_design.purpose: diagnose chronology and execution-environment sensitivity without changing acceptance thresholds

task_execution_audit.scope: whole taskset child, including benchmark setup, warmup, measurements, allocation sample, and receipt emission

validity.metric: GNU time %P (task user+system CPU time divided by task wall time)
validity.rationale: with all child threads pinned to one logical CPU, a 99% reported task CPU share bounds visible scheduler/preemption loss to about one percent, below the m4 two-percent median/geomean tolerance
validity.context_switch_policy: voluntary and involuntary counts are recorded for diagnosis but are not gated because switch counts do not measure descheduled duration

diagnostics.purpose: diagnostic strata only; acceptance still uses the unchanged campaign gates
